texts: On day 68 of Year 1, Pell told Coraline Ash that sky-cats molt while they hunt.
Pell told Coraline Ash that molting sky-cats drop feathers.
Coraline Ash wrote in the notebook that a thin sky-cat year brings a thin feather harvest.
Old Vesh told Pell that the village always keeps the Stilllight Lantern lit.
